name: Bot Team for Orca
description: A team of bots inside Orca. Runs the open-source OpenMausBot on your machine: a roster of bots, each its own Claude, Codex or Grok agent. Unofficial. Not made by or affiliated with Orca, OpenMausBot or the makers of the models it runs.

commands.title: Bot Team for Orca: Open chat
Bot Team for Orca: Stop the OpenMausBot server

settings.title: Give Claude bots my Claude tools
settings.description: Claude bots use the connectors, MCP servers, skills and instructions from your Claude setup. More tools means more tokens per message. Turn off to give Claude bots only what you add in OpenMausBot.

settings.title: Install updates automatically
settings.description: Bot Team for Orca checks GitHub for a newer release every six hours while its panel is open, retrying network failures after one minute. Turn on to install it without asking. An update that asks for new access always waits for your approval.

settings.title: Let my Orca agents talk to the bots
settings.description: Adds Bot Team for Orca's tools to Claude, Codex, opencode and Antigravity on this computer. Links survive plugin uninstall; turn off to remove them first.
